Karnataka Ministers Address Water Projects and Disaster Relief

Karnataka Ministers have been active on multiple fronts, urging the central government to fund the Yettinahole Project under the Jal Jeevan Mission. Separately, a minister announced ex gratia payments and urged caution following a wall collapse in Nagori, disbursing compensation to victims' families. Another minister stated that the release of Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu is an authority's decision.
